scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview && npm run dev --workspace @worldview/viewer
scripts.dev:editor: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview && npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && npm run build --workspace @worldview/protocol && npm run dev --workspace @worldview/editor
scripts.dev:collaboration: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && npm run build --workspace @worldview/protocol && npm run dev --workspace @worldview/collaboration-service
scripts.dev:collaboration:celld: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && npm run build --workspace @worldview/protocol && celld dev apps/collaboration-service --port 8787 --logs
scripts.deploy:collaboration:celld-azurite: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && npm run build --workspace @worldview/protocol && node scripts/deploy-celld-azurite.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview && npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && npm run build --workspace @worldview/protocol && npm run build --workspace @worldview/compiler-service && npm run build --workspace @worldview/collaboration-service && npm run build --workspace @worldview/service && npm run build --workspace @worldview/viewer && npm run build --workspace @worldview/editor
scripts.build:browser-tests: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview && npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && npm run build --workspace @worldview/protocol
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:browser-tests && npm run test:consumer && playwright test
scripts.test:browser:ci: npm run build:browser-tests && npm run test:consumer && playwright test --grep @ci-smoke --workers=1
scripts.test:browser:editor: npm run build:browser-tests && WORLDVIEW_PLAYWRIGHT_SCOPE=editor playwright test tests/browser/editor/ --project=chromium --workers=1
scripts.test:browser:viewer: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview && npm run test:consumer && WORLDVIEW_PLAYWRIGHT_SCOPE=viewer playwright test tests/browser/viewer.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:editor-performance: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && WORLDVIEW_PLAYWRIGHT_SCOPE=editor WORLDVIEW_PERF_GATE=1 playwright test tests/browser/editor-performance.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.release:check: npm run check:viewer && npm run test:browser:viewer && npm run test:package
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview && npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview-editor && npm run build --workspace @worldview/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:viewer: npm run build --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview && npm run typecheck --workspace @jackharrhy/worldview && npm run typecheck --workspace @worldview/viewer
scripts.lint:viewer: oxlint packages/worldview apps/viewer tests/consumer tests/browser/viewer.spec.ts scripts/publish.mjs playwright.config.ts --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives
scripts.format:check:viewer: oxfmt --check packages/worldview apps/viewer tests/consumer tests/browser/viewer.spec.ts scripts/publish.mjs playwright.config.ts README.md docs/plan.md docs/releasing.md docs/viewer-api.md
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:theme && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:collaboration-bakeoff && npm run test:collaboration-celld-compat && npm run build && npm run check:editor-routes:build && npm run test:consumer && npm run test:package
scripts.check:viewer: npm run format:check:viewer && npm run lint:viewer && npm run typecheck:viewer && npm run test:viewer
